headline: A 2014 law renames a Veterans Affairs clinic in Junction City, Kansas, after Lieutenant General Richard J. Seitz.
what_it_does: The law gives a new official name to the Junction City Community-Based Outpatient Clinic at 715 Southwind Drive in Junction City, Kansas. The clinic will be called the Lieutenant General Richard J. Seitz Community-Based Outpatient Clinic. The law changes only the name and does not change the clinic's services, staff, or location.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2014.
